text:
alex_g: FYI vendor flagged a partial allocation holdback for EU H100s. They want a firm "pricing ceiling" confirmation before they release the air top-up. ETA moved +3–4wks. Need quick decision on contingency (loaners vs air-expedite) and RMA forwarder for returns. :eyes:
sophia_procure: what's the quoted delta vs committed price? can we absorb or negotiate?
juan_vendor: vendor says extra +8% for air lane due to capacity. will drop to +5% if we accept top-up as a single AWB and cover brokerage.
mina_ops: 8% is rough but timeline matters. If we lose capacity in EU clusters we're looking at customer impact for high-priority queues. Recommend loaners for immediate relief and air top-up for replenishment.
leo_sre: +1 for loaners to avoid throttling. How fast can we get depot handoff once loaners arrive?
sophia_procure: need to confirm cost-sharing. proposal: Redwood pays 30% expedite premium, vendor absorbs 70% if they committed earlier lead time. any objections?
juan_vendor: vendor counters — 50/50 split or they keep holdback. they also request HS code clarification to speed customs: use `HS 8471.80` and include warranty docs.
alex_g: noted. can we get vendor to print `warranty` and `replacement` on paperwork to avoid classification issues?
mina_ops: also need Forwarder SLA — prefer someone with depot acceptance in NL/DE within 48h. suggestions?
leo_sre: AirSprint had good SLAs in last round, but ask for a written depot pickup window.
juan_vendor: vendor recommends EuroParcel or AirSprint. EuroParcel cheaper but slower pickup windows. AirSprint can do 48h but higher surcharge.
sophia_procure: request formal quote: two options with line items (air-surcharge, brokerage, insurance). we need numbers to commit to ceiling.
alex_g: @rma-bot can you pre-create return path and RMA number we can reference on AWB and paperwork so depot doesn't delay?
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-5238. Please include RMA-5238 on all shipping docs and photos.
mina_ops: perfect. also push vendor to share sample AWB and manifest format. here's a snippet we prefer: ```
AWB: 125-EXA-4321
Pieces: 10
Declared value: EUR 200,000
RMA: RMA-5238
HS: 8471.80
```
juan_vendor: will share full AWB set by EOD.
sophia_procure: once we have quotes, we set a ceiling and sign conditional release. target: Redwood max +6% expedite premium. vendor to cover remainder above 6%.
leo_sre: if vendor won't accept 6% cap, fallback = loaners + sea replenishment and schedule regional throttles. we should model cost of customer impact vs premium.
alex_g: action items: 1) vendor to send two quotes (AirSprint priority & EuroParcel economy) by EOD — @juan_vendor 2) Vendor to attach RMA-5238 on docs — @juan_vendor 3) Procurement to respond w/ ceiling decision by 12:00 UTC tomorrow — @sophia_procure 4) Ops to prepare loaner list and depot acceptance windows — @mina_ops
sophia_procure: ack. I'll draft a conditional release: "Redwood agrees to expedite up to +6% surcharge; vendor covers any surcharge above +6% if vendor is late beyond original ETA." will circulate. :memo:
mina_ops: prepping loaner manifest now — will post depot list and pickup SLA expectations in #eng-logistics.
juan_vendor: quotes incoming. I'll push for vendor to accept the 6% cap and include printed RMA on docs.
leo_sre: once quotes are in, run quick calc: cost_of_premium vs estimated revenue loss if queues constrained. I'll take that.
alex_g: thanks all — let's reconvene after quotes. :thumbsup:
